text: Let me be weighed in an even balance: Heb. let him weigh me in balances of Justice
did not one fashion us in the womb?: Or, did he not fashion us in one womb?
the Sun: Heb. the light | in brightness: Heb. bright
my mouth hath kissed my hand: Heb. my hand hath kissed my mouth
to the traveller: Or, to the way
as Adam: Or, after the manner of men
behold, my desire, that the Almighty would answer me: Or, behold my sign is that the Almighty will answer me
the fruits thereof: Heb. the strength thereof | caused the owners thereof to lose their life: Heb. caused the soul of the owners thereof to expire, or breath out
